facts.statement: Platysuchus lived during the Early Jurassic (Toarcian) period.
facts.quote: Platysuchus ("flat crocodile") is an extinct genus of teleosaurid crocodyliform from the Early Jurassic (Toarcian) of southern Germany and Luxembourg.

facts.statement: Fossils of Platysuchus have been found in marine deposits in southern Germany and Luxembourg.
facts.quote: Platysuchus has been found in Toarcian age marine deposits in southern Germany and Luxembourg.

facts.statement: Platysuchus was originally described as the species Mystriosaurus multiscrobiculatus.
facts.quote: Platysuchus was originally described as a member of the genus Mystriosaurus, as M. multiscrobiculatus.

facts.statement: Westphal renamed the species Platysuchus in 1961 after determining it was distinct from the genus Mystriosaurus.
facts.quote: However, Westphal (1961) found M. multiscrobiculatus generically distinct from Mystriosaurus and renamed it Platysuchus.

facts.statement: The genus authority for Platysuchus is Westphal, 1961.
facts.quote: However, Westphal (1961) found M. multiscrobiculatus generically distinct from Mystriosaurus and renamed it Platysuchus.

facts.statement: Platysuchus belongs to the suborder Thalattosuchia.
Platysuchus is classified within the family Teleosauridae.
The type species of the genus Platysuchus is Platysuchus multiscrobiculatus.
Platysuchus lived between 184.2 and 182.9 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Toarcian to Toarcian (184.2 to 182.9 million years ago)

facts.statement: There are four recorded fossil occurrences of Platysuchus in the Paleobiology Database.
